desc:
ICE SLIDE POLICE PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game!

Escape the prison before the police catch you! Run through 25 fun obstacle stages filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms, and dangerous traps. Dodge obstacles, avoid the police, and make your way to freedom.

Play solo or with friends as you race through each stage. Challenge yourself to beat your best time and reach the end faster. Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and exciting obby challenges for all players.

Can you escape the prison and survive the police?

Tags: Obby, Parkour, Platformer, Prison, Escape, Run, Stages, Fun, Family Friendly, Adventure
